_about: Public-domain John Franklin Genung (1850-1919), professor at Amherst and scholar of the Bible as literature, for the Word Hoard: The Epic of the Inner Life (Job translated anew), Words of Koheleth (Ecclesiastes translated anew), The Hebrew Literature of Wisdom, A Guidebook to the Biblical Literature, and What a Carpenter did with his Bible. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 109 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

genung-epic-inner-life: The epic of the inner life : being the book of Job (Boston : Houghton, Mifflin, 1893)
genung-carpenter: What a carpenter did with his Bible: an address by John Franklin Genung (New York, Boston, T. Y. Crowell & company, 1898)
genung-koheleth: Ecclesiastes : words of Koheleth, son of David, King in Jerusalem (Boston : Houghton, Mifflin, 1904)
genung-hebrew-wisdom: The Hebrew literature of wisdom in the light of to-day; a synthesis (Boston and New York, Houghton, Mifflin and company, 1906)
genung-guidebook: A guidebook to the Biblical literature (Boston, New York [etc.] Ginn and company, 1919)

_excluded.genung-rhetoric: His rhetoric textbooks and the Tennyson study are not theology; left out
